backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a simple favorites store with add, remove, and get operations for (title, URL) pairs persisted in a mutable list.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping four wallpaper-related features (adding White Plaid Lace and Dark Stussy Grunge options) to their affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and notable details of every component, page, hook, and data file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the Kitsch-io React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Query and TanStack Router with routes for Home, Games, Movies, and Music pages under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a browser game's title, category badge, description, and an external Play Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout shell that owns the usePersonalization instance, renders a fixed wallpaper background layer with overlay, a header with navigation links, and a Style button that opens the PersonalizationPanel.
frontend/src/components/MovieCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a movie's title, year, genre badge, synopsis, and an external Watch Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/PersonalizationP: Modal overlay panel that displays 10 wallpaper thumbnail options (including White Plaid Lace and Dark Stussy Grunge) in a 4-column grid and an overlay darkness slider, accepting a personalization hook as a prop.
frontend/src/components/ShowCard.tsx: A React card component for displaying a TV/anime show with title, episode count, genre, description, and a 'Watch Now' link button with customizable accent color.
frontend/src/components/TrackCard.tsx: A React card component for displaying a music track with title, artist, genre, an inline HTML audio player, and an optional source link.
frontend/src/components/widgets/ClockWid: A small widget that displays a live-updating digital clock with hours, minutes, seconds, and the current date, updating every second via an interval.
frontend/src/components/widgets/Favorite: A widget for managing a list of favorite links, supporting adding and removing favorites via React Query hooks with a toggleable inline form.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MoodBoar: A widget that lets users select and persist a current mood (emoji + label) from a predefined list, storing the selection in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MusicTic: A small widget that displays a horizontally scrolling ticker of hardcoded classical music track names with a CSS animation.
frontend/src/data/anime.ts: A static data file exporting a large array of anime show objects (title, episodes, genre, description, watchUrl), covering classic and older anime series.
frontend/src/data/c-drama.ts: A static data file exporting an array of Chinese drama show objects with metadata including title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/games.ts: A static data file exporting a large array of classic/retro game objects (id, title, category, description, url) spanning multiple genres, primarily linking to Internet Archive.
frontend/src/data/j-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Japanese drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/k-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Korean drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and watch URLs across Viki, Netflix, and Kocowa.
frontend/src/data/movies.ts: Defines a Movie interface and exports a large array of movies spanning multiple eras, each with title, year, genre, synopsis, and Internet Archive watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/music.ts: Defines a Track interface and exports an array of public domain classical and orchestral music tracks with artist, genre, and Internet Archive audio/source URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChat.ts: Custom React hook managing chat state for an AI assistant named Kitschy, handling message history, sending messages via an AI service, loading state, and error handling with a clearHistory utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP blockchain, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersonalization.ts: Hook that manages user personalization settings (background texture and overlay opacity) with localStorage persistence and a helper to resolve texture image URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and removing user favorites via a canister actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme color system, and styles scrollbars and audio elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AIAssistant.tsx: Chat UI page featuring a conversational AI assistant with message bubbles, a loading indicator, and keyboard-accessible input using the useChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Anime.tsx: Anime browsing page that displays a filterable, searchable grid of anime shows using genre select and text search inputs.
frontend/src/pages/CDrama.tsx: C-Drama browsing page that renders a searchable and genre-filterable grid of Chinese drama series using ShowCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Games.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable grid of 20 browser-based games (with categories like Puzzle, Arcade, Strategy) using a GameCard component and category/search state.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for KitschHub showing a hero section, banner image, and three navigation cards linking to the Games, Movies, and Music sections.
frontend/src/pages/JDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Japanese drama series with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a grid of ShowCard components from the j-drama data source.
frontend/src/pages/KDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Korean drama series with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a grid of ShowCard components from the k-drama data source.
frontend/src/pages/Movies.tsx: Movies browsing page with search, genre, and decade filters over a public-domain movie dataset, displaying results in a responsive MovieCard grid.
frontend/src/pages/Music.tsx: Music page listing public-domain audio tracks (classical, jazz, ragtime, etc.) from archive.org with search and genre filtering, rendered via TrackCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx: A settings page that lets users select a background wallpaper from a grid of 10 texture options and adjust overlay opacity, with selections persisted via the usePersonalization hook.
frontend/src/services/aiService.ts: Sends chat messages to the Mistral-7B Hugging Face inference API with a system prompt for the 'Kitschy' assistant, falling back to hardcoded keyword-based responses on failure.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based semantic colors, Bebas Neue/Inter fonts, zero border-radius, silver glow shadows, and typography/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the KitschHub project state at version 3, documenting existing features, a pending request to add 'White Plaid Lace' and 'Dark Stussy Grunge' wallpapers, and the required image asset descriptions.
